svg.title: Instances deliver to their own sockets
svg.desc: A broker sorter feeding two local connection consoles. The broker delivers to instances. Each instance writes to its own connected browsers.
svg.text: Instances deliver to their own sockets
Browser A sends an HTTP write to Instance 1, which validates and commits.
Publish the board-412 event to the broker. An outbox or CDC path can also append
The broker delivers to subscribed Instance 1 and Instance 2.
Instance 1 writes to its Browser C socket; Instance 2 writes to its Browser B
socket. Each enforces subscription and authorization.
